svg.title: Delivery signal and velocity confidence
svg.desc: PR CI run 39922014929 passed all six jobs, including ASan/UBSan portable C fixtures; Rust test totals are 305 Linux and 304 Windows. These results show strong software integration momentum. No sprint estimates, burn-down series, or scope-normalized throughput data exists, so velocity is not quantified. Product acceptance evidence remains zero of eleven rows.
svg.text: Momentum is positive; velocity is not yet measurable
Do not convert test growth or commit counts into a delivery-rate forecast without a sized backlog and iteration history.
